rec.name: PDP Interactive Product Benefits Explorer (Hotspot Overview with Feature Tabs)
rec.status: Reference only (screenshot only, no ticket spec)

what.text: A PDP section titled 'Learn more' (German: 'Mehr erfahren') with the product name as an eyebrow label ('Classic Jeans') and a short intro line: 'Here you can take a closer look at the item and learn everything about its features.' A large product cutout sits in the middle with three round white icon hotspots overlaid: a feature/network icon, a magnifier and a play button. Beneath the image is a vertical accordion-style navigation list with four rows, each with an icon and a chevron: Overview (active, dark), Special Features, Watch Video, View Details (inactive, grey). A floating black chat button sits at the bottom right.

why.text: Shoppers cannot touch the product online, so the section lets them self-select the depth of information they want (key features, video, zoomed detail) without leaving the PDP. Interactive hotspots on the product create curiosity and engagement. Clear grouping of benefits lowers cognitive load and uncertainty, which reduces hesitation and returns. Video and zoom views are especially valuable for fit and quality-sensitive apparel.

how.text: Build a dedicated PDP section with a heading, a subtext and a central product image (transparent cutout). Overlay absolutely positioned hotspot buttons (percentage-based x/y) that open the matching content panel: features, video or detail zoom. Below, render a tab/accordion list with icon, label and chevron; the active item is highlighted and the others greyed. Each item swaps the content shown (overview image with hotspots, feature callouts, video player, zoom/detail gallery). The content per product is likely driven by metafields (video URL, feature list, detail images). On mobile, keep the list full-width with large tap targets.

items: Hotspot positions (x/y) and icon per hotspot
Tab list items: label, icon, linked content type (features / video / details)
Feature content (text and icons) per product

dependencies.text: Likely product metafields for features, video and detail images; the theme needs a section with blocks for the tabs. The chat widget visible in the screenshot is a separate app and not part of this element. No ticket spec exists, so these dependencies are assumed.

items: Add-to-cart rate for sessions that engage vs. those that don't

images.caption: Mobile PDP 'Mehr erfahren' section: product cutout with three icon hotspots (features, zoom, video) and a tab list (Overview, Special Features, Watch Video, View Details).
Active/inactive tab styling and the chevron list beneath the product image.
